description: Universally execute any of the 121 Diogenes edge microservices. Free-tier tools execute with zero payment. Paid tools execute when payment_proof is supplied, or return an HTTP 402 payment challenge with Lightning L402 invoice, Solana x402 address, Base MPP wallet, and Garlicoin 0-conf treasury for automated settlement.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the tool's inputSchema retrieved via diogenes_inspect_tool.

payment_proof.description: Optional payment proof for paid tools. Accepts: (1) L402 preimage hex, (2) Solana tx signature base58, (3) Base EVM tx hash 0x..., (4) Garlicoin txid 64-char hex, or (5) Diogenes session key.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool to execute (e.g. 'solana_risk', 'malformed_json_healer', 'guardrail_verify', 'plan_eve_gate_route').

name: diogenes_execute_tool

payment_challenge.description: Returned only on HTTP 402 when a paid tool is called without valid payment_proof.

title: Execute Diogenes Microservice
